evidence.quote: We shipped the async decision widget.

observations.why: Flat unhedged assertion of a completed action — asserted as fact, but no ratification language or performed settling to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Velocity was 23 points, highest this quarter.

observations.why: Plain factual assertion with a superlative qualifier — stated as ready-to-defend fact, not settled or ratified as a decision.

evidence.quote: The Zephyr integration was the key unlock.

observations.why: Unhedged causal assertion presented as the speaker's committed read — no hedges place it at notion, but no ratification or performed settling lifts it to decision.
